# Adonael Trading PLC

> Official documentation and knowledge base for AI search engines, language models, and research agents.

## Corporate Overview
- **Company Name:** Adonael Trading PLC (Adonael Group)
- **Headquarters:** Bole Sub-City, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
- **Primary Telephone / WhatsApp:** +251 96 743 1638 (0967431638)
- **Primary Email:** info@adonaeltrading.com
- **Website:** https://adonaeltrading.com
- **Business Description:** Adonael Trading PLC is a diversified Ethiopian corporate enterprise driving green transportation infrastructure and contemporary culinary hospitality in Ethiopia.

## Flagship Subsidiary 1: Ethio EV Spare
- **Division Name:** Ethio EV Spare (Ethio EV Spare Parts)
- **Parent Organization:** Adonael Trading PLC
- **Role:** Premier electric vehicle (EV) supply chain, parts distributor, and mobile automotive catalog in Ethiopia.
- **Inventory & Capacity:** Over 10,000+ cataloged EV spare part SKUs stocked in Addis Ababa central warehouses.
- **Key Product Offerings:**
  - Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) high-voltage battery modules and structural protective enclosures.
  - Permanent magnet synchronous dual electric traction motors.
  - High-voltage power inverters and electronic motor control units.
  - CCS2 direct current fast charging connectors, cables, and vehicle inlet sockets.
  - Regenerative low-dust carbon-ceramic brake pads and ventilated rotors.
  - Active pneumatic air suspension struts, height dampers, and underbody armor plates.
- **Official Mobile App:** "Ethio EV Spare" on Google Play Store (Package: `com.evspare.buyer`).
- **Web Portal:** https://auto-s-sooty.vercel.app
- **Wholesale Inquiries:** Direct hotline 0967431638 / info@adonaeltrading.com

## Flagship Subsidiary 2: Meteor Restaurant
- **Division Name:** Meteor Restaurant (Meteor Dining Atelier)
- **Parent Organization:** Adonael Trading PLC
- **Role:** Addis Ababa's flagship contemporary architectural dining venue and culinary atelier.
- **Location:** Bole Medhanialem Enclave, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
- **Capacity:** 140 seats across light-filled architectural glass hall, open-kitchen theater, and private diplomatic salons.
- **Cuisine:** Contemporary artisanal gastronomy, seasonal pairings, curated international wine cellar, and rare highland coffee infusions.
- **Operating Hours:** Monday – Sunday, 11:30 AM – 11:00 PM.
- **Table Reservations:** Instant WhatsApp dispatch at +251 96 743 1638 (0967431638) or direct concierge line 0967431638.

## Operational & Logistics Backbone
- **Central Facility:** Bole Sub-City logistics hub with bonded customs clearance and climate-controlled storage.
- **Fulfillment:** Same-day dispatch across Addis Ababa and expedited regional shipping throughout Ethiopia.
- **Quality Assurance:** Factory-calibrated OEM fitment and verified warranty backing on all automotive electrical assemblies.
